kjv.text: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

bsb.text: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.

web.text: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

leads.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

reasons: says "three things" but the note has no counted things
morning.phrase is not found word for word in the note

flow.say: Henry shows us three things about Christ in this verse: who he is, what he wears, and what he is called.
Christ's attributes reveal his complete power and authority over all things.
His blood-stained garment speaks of his victory and the price he paid for his rule.

morning.say: Carry with you today the mystery of Christ's name and what it means for your life.
morning.phrase: The Word was God manifest in the flesh
